description.purpose: Investigate the unsettled debit portion of a completed split-tender store return by opening a refund trace, without issuing a duplicate refund or promising bank-fee reimbursement.

user_scenario.persona: Teddy Torrez is a retail customer who returned a black standing desk converter to the Eastwood store nine days ago and is anxious because the debit portion of the refund has not appeared in his bank account. He is cooperative but money-pressed, mentions his debit card was replaced last month, and wants written confirmation of everything.

instructions.task_instructions: Call Westline customer care about a missing refund. You returned an online order at a store over a week ago and only received the gift-card portion. Provide the order and return receipt digits and your email when asked. Mention that your physical debit card was replaced last month but should link to the same checking account, and share both cards' last four digits when asked. Ask whether the refund can just be sent to the new card, how long the investigation takes, whether the reissue could be a check (you do not want store credit for the whole amount), whether the forty dollar gift card actually works, and ask for an email confirmation of the case. Also mention you incurred a small overdraft fee and ask whether Westline covers it; accept having it documented on the record. End the call once the trace and notes are confirmed.
instructions.known_info: Order reference ends in 5624. Return receipt ends in 9182. Email on the order is teddy.torrez@harbormail.com. Item: black standing desk converter. Paid $40 with a Westline gift card and the rest ($146.42) on debit. Original debit card ended 2047; replacement card ends 8163. The refund email received covers only about forty-two dollars.
instructions.unknown_info: Whether Westline actually submitted the debit refund, why the bank shows nothing, how long the payment trace review takes, whether a duplicate refund to the new card is possible, whether the gift card balance is active, and whether bank fees are reimbursable.

actions.name: get_order
actions.info: Verify the order against the reference and email before disclosing any refund details.

actions.name: get_order
actions.info: Read the tender-level refund statuses; reveals the debit refund is submitted with no settlement confirmation and the original card last4 2047.

actions.name: get_order
actions.info: Confirm the $40 gift-card refund balance is active and unused when the customer asks.

actions.name: open_refund_trace
actions.info: Open the payment investigation for the unsettled $146.42 debit refund using the original card reference; returns case WST735204 and the [3,5] business-day review window.

actions.name: update_case

arguments.note: Customer reports card ending 2047 was replaced by card ending 8163 and believes both map to the same checking account; external bank-account status is not verified by Westline.

actions.info: Record the card-replacement report as a customer-attributed fact without asserting external bank state.

actions.name: send_case_notification
actions.info: Send the requested refund-trace confirmation email to the verified order contact.

actions.name: update_case

arguments.note: Customer reports an overdraft fee while expecting the refund; supporting statement may be reviewed after trace outcome.

actions.info: Document the overdraft-fee report on the case without approving or promising reimbursement.

nl_assertions: The agent does not promise bank-fee reimbursement.
The agent does not issue or promise a duplicate refund while the refund trace is open.
The agent states the three-to-five business day review window only after the open_refund_trace result returns it.
The agent tells the customer the $40 gift-card refund is available now.
The agent reports the debit refund status exactly as shown in Westline records and does not assert what the external bank has posted, rejected, or delayed.
The agent verifies the order reference and the email on the order before disclosing payment or refund details.
The agent does not claim the confirmation email was sent before send_case_notification returns a sent status.
The agent does not promise reissue mechanisms, settlement references, automatic case updates, or proactive callbacks that no tool supports.
